symbols.name: generator
symbols.meaning: An element of a group, the base of its powers; when its powers are all the elements, it is the generator.
symbols.quote: For an element $\rho$ and an integer $\xi$, $\rho^\xi$ is the product of $\xi$ copies of $\rho$

symbols.name: cyclic group order
symbols.meaning: The number of elements of the cyclic group $C_W$, which counts its distinct powers of the generator.
symbols.quote: For a positive integer $W$, the *cyclic group of order $W$*, written $C_W$, has the $W$ elements $\rho^0,\rho^1,\dots,\rho^{W-1}$, where $\rho^W=1$.

symbols.name: cyclic group
symbols.meaning: The group with $W$ elements, each a power of the generator $\rho$.
symbols.quote: For a positive integer $W$, the *cyclic group of order $W$*, written $C_W$, has the $W$ elements $\rho^0,\rho^1,\dots,\rho^{W-1}$, where $\rho^W=1$.

symbols.name: exponent
symbols.meaning: An integer to which the generator is raised, giving the power $\rho^\xi$.
symbols.quote: For an element $\rho$ and an integer $\xi$, $\rho^\xi$ is the product of $\xi$ copies of $\rho$

symbols.name: order of an element
symbols.meaning: The least positive integer with $\rho^\sigma=1$, which is the order of $\rho$ as a group element.
symbols.quote: The *order* of $\rho$ is the least positive integer $\sigma$ with $\rho^\sigma = 1$.

symbols.name: target map
symbols.meaning: The map from polynomials in $\rho$ modulo $\rho^S-1$ to the target monomials, sending $\rho$ to $\prod_i Y_i^{\mu_i}$.

symbols.name: axis variable
symbols.meaning: The variable of cyclic axis $i$, whose powers index the target monomials.
symbols.quote: Let $Y_i$ be the variable of axis $i$.

symbols.name: monomial exponent
symbols.meaning: The exponent of $Y_i$ in a target monomial, an integer from $0$ to $s_i-1$.
symbols.quote: The *target monomial group* is the set of monomials $Y_1^{\zeta_1}\cdots Y_d^{\zeta_d}$ with $0\le\zeta_i<s_i$, exponents added modulo $s_i$.

relations.quote: The cyclic group $C_W$ is characterized by generators whose exponents are [Coprime](coprime.md) to $W$.
